t: The Love Boat: Lonely At The Top / Silent Night / Divorce Me, Please
st: Lonely At The Top / Silent Night / Divorce Me, Please
d: In a Christmas-themed cruise, the captain worries about how to effectively lead his ship but be a friend to his crew as well. A married couple who outwardly appear happy and in love are both desperate for the other person to give them a divorce.

t: The Love Boat: Too Many Dads/ Love Will Find A Way/ The Best Of Friends
st: Too Many Dads/ Love Will Find A Way/ The Best Of Friends
d: A 10-year-old boy is torn between his biological father, who he hasn't seen since he was a baby, and the stepfather who raised him. Meanwhile, Elaine tries to tell her parents that her fiance is a paraplegic.

t: The Love Boat: The Christmas Presence
d: Angelorum Dominicus suddenly appears aboard the Pacific Princess without a reservation and soon begins to spread love and happiness to everyone on the cruise, especially a little boy in need of an operation.

t: The Love Boat: The Christmas Show: Santa, Santa, Santa/ Another Dog Gone Christmas/ Noel's Christmas Carol
st: The Christmas Show: Santa, Santa, Santa/ Another Dog Gone Christmas/ Noel's Christmas Carol
d: On a special Christmas cruise, no fewer than three Santas vie to entertain the passengers and a faded comedian gets a new lease on life.
Christmas cheer goes stale this year when a crazed gunman who is also an air traffic controller holds the gang in the airport hostage for a jelly donut.
Helen throws her first Christmas party and all of her guests have their wallets stolen.
This year, Christmas Eve is spent in a cab with a nun, in a department store basementhiding from carolers.

st: The Last Call for Aunt Julie
d: Aunt Julie comes to visit for Thanksgiving and brings her drinking problem with her.
Matt works as the shopping mall Santa, and Eric and Annie exchange gifts from the heart on this 7th Heaven Christmas. Tim Conway guest stars.
Becker starts to appreciate life after spending an evening in the morgue identifying one of his patients.
John believes that Christmas is a phony time of the year. Instead of embracing the Christmas spirit, he uses getting robbed as vindication for his position.
At the diner, John expresses his repulsion for all the Christmas decorations.
When Annie's mother shows up on Annie's doorstep with suitcase in hand, Caroline  finds herself caught in the middle.

st: Caroline And The Used Car Salesman
d: Discreetly planning to ease Caroline’s homesick holiday blues, Richard (Malcolm Gets) goes to great lengths to get a gift for Caroline that inspires suspicion in Julia (Sofia Milos) and sleuthing from Caroline and Annie.

Sam køber en 'sidste øjeblik'-julegave til Rebecca fra en anden handlende.
Sam går til ekstremer for at prøve at købe sin gamle bil tilbage.

t: Blomsterbørns børn: No Nukes Is Good Nukes
d: To the dismay of the Keaton children and their equally conservative grandparents, Steven and Elyse take time out Thanksgiving Day to attend an anti-nuke rally-and end up spending the holiday in jail.

t: Blomsterbørns børn: A Keaton Christmas Carol
d: A cynical Alex finds the spirit of Christmas in a dream.
A bearded visitor turns Alex into a believer at Christmas.

d: The Cunningham family plans a quiet, old-fashioned family Christmas until Richie discovers Fonzie faces a lonely holiday.

MacGyver and the kids at the Challenge Center discover the meaning of Christmas when they befriend a mysterious homeless woman.
Matlock serves double duty: defending Brian Emerson, who’s charged with killing his ex-wife, and babysitting Emerson’s 6-year-old daughter.
